description: Searches the Strale capability registry by keyword, category, or natural language query. Use this when you need to find the right capability for a task but don't know the exact slug. Returns matching capabilities and solutions ranked by relevance, each with slug, name, description, category, and price in EUR cents. The registry spans company data, compliance, finance, web intelligence, and developer tools. No API key required to search.

category.description: Filter by category: compliance, validation, data-extraction, developer-tools, web3, security, domain-intel, recruiting, sales, legal, text

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination). Default: 0

query.description: Search keyword (matched against name, description, slug)

name: strale_search
title: Search tools and bundles
